manufacturer.name: Rollease Acmeda
manufacturer.note: Tubular motor and control manufacturer for roller shutters and blinds, with an Australian division. The documentation area is named member-documents, which suggests it may be gated; the harvester will record that honestly rather than assume either way. Beyond the sign-in-gated member area, it also serves instruction PDFs openly from rolleaseacmeda.com/docs/default-source, foldered by market and motor family, and runs a separate brand site at automateshades.com. Both are registered as harvest targets and neither needs a login.
